title: DOW-UAP-PR101, Unresolved UAP Report, South China Sea, 2024
what_is_it: A US government case file consisting of infrared video footage of an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP), released with a written description of what the video shows.
interpretation_warnings: The document supplies no identification of the object; the case is unresolved and the label 'UAP' means unidentified, not evidence of anything anomalous.
The written video description is explicitly for informational purposes only and readers are cautioned not to over-interpret it.
Single-source military sensor footage with no corroborating instrumentation or witness detail provided.
'Areas of contrast' on an infrared sensor can have mundane explanations (aircraft, birds, thermal artefacts) that the release does not rule in or out.
No source text was extractable from the PDF; the extraction relies almost entirely on the war.gov metadata and the supplied video description.
